results.title: Aglaspidida (Arthropoda) from the Upper Cambrian of Wisconsin
results.snippet: ABSTRACT-New specimens of aglaspidid arthropods, mainly from the Upper Cambrian St. Lawrence (Upper Dikelocephalus Zone), show that appendages previously assigned to the genotype Aglaspis new genus and species Flobertia kochi. Chraspedops fragilis is transferred to a new genus Tuboculops. Aglaspis dorsetensis and Aglaspis franconensis is queried.

results.title: Trace Fossils of Cambrian Aglaspidid Arthropods
results.snippet: A new trace fossil, Raaschichnus gundersoni, from the Upper Cambrian St. Lawrence Formation of Wisconsin, was produced by an aglaspidid arthropod. The rusophyciform trace, which occurs singly and in series, is distintive in showing marks left by the tail-spine.

results.title: Aglaspidida (Arthropoda) from the Upper Cambrian of Wisconsin
results.snippet: Abstract New specimens of aglaspidid arthropods, mainly from the Upper Cambrian St. Lawrence Formation of Wisconsin (Upper Dikelocephalus Zone), show that appendages previously assigned to the genotype Aglaspis barrandei actually belong to a new genus and species Flobertia kochi. Chraspedops fragilis is transferred to a new genus Tuboculops.

results.snippet: Agnostus pisiformis: The agnostids — an arthropod order found from the early Cambrian period to the late Ordovician, which peaked in diversity during the middle Cambrian — have long been considered a highly unusual group of trilobites.

results.title: The Cambrian Period: How animals exploded onto the scene
results.snippet: The largest phylum - the one that contains the most species - is Arthropoda. Arthropods have segmented bodies, tough exoskeletons and jointed appendages, such as antennae, mouthparts and legs. Trilobites are the characteristic arthropods of the Cambrian. They evolved rapidly and over time displayed a great variety of eyes, armour and sizes.

Other key features of these invertebrate animals include segmented bodies and external skeletons. Their exoskeletons are made of chitin, a tough fibrous polymer.
